scope: Classical derived-fiber reaction feedback and controlled braid-memory readout. Positive combinatorial charge is not physical energy; no quantum amplitudes, emergent geometry, or binding asserted.

bank.selection: All minimal gauge/orientation-equivariant product-preserving involutions with a strictly positive additive class charge and a changing occupied-face count. No feedback or observed trajectory enters selection.

full_bundle_spectral_capacity.identity: 2(12 I - L_bundle) = sum_f embedded(S_f) + 2 direct_sum_v J_3
full_bundle_spectral_capacity.stronger_identity: 12 I - L_bundle = sum_{f of either one orientation} embedded(S_f) + direct_sum_v J_3
full_bundle_spectral_capacity.conclusion: On the supplied triangular tori, n_+(L_bundle - 12 I) <= min(Q_up,Q_down) <= floor(Q/2). Only Q=Q_up+Q_down is conserved; neither the orientation-resolved capacity nor the actual mode count is generally conserved.
